parsed.rationale: The second participating record, `MockNotificationMessage` in `Shared/Core/Sources/CoreTesting/_Plant_MockNotificationMessage.swift`, carries `is_test: true`. Under the decision rules, any cluster containing a test-marked record must be treated as a test-fixture and no structural refactor should be applied. Although both protocols share an identical field set (`makeMessage`, `makeNotification`, `name`), `MockNotificationMessage` exists precisely to mirror `MainActorNotificationMessage` for test purposes; introducing a shared parent protocol would couple production semantics to test infrastructure. The `_Plant_` prefix in the file name further signals this is a generated or deliberately isolated test double, reinforcing that the duplication is intentional.
